findings.problem: The argument "an element g of prime order p ≥ 5 cannot lie in the kernel of the Levi hom, because the kernel is a 2-group, so some coordinate of the image is nontrivial" is proved inline here. The same proof appears in `exists_uniLeviHom_ne_one` in L6LeavesKFactParabolicLeviSubUBlocks.lean and in the `hβ`/`hcon` block in L6LeavesKFactParabolicLeviSubOPBlocks.lean. Each copy repeats the same steps: get k from the p-group kernel, form g^(2^k)=1, get p ∣ 2^k, conclude p = 2, then use funext on the Pi-valued image to find a nontrivial coordinate. Only the hom and the kernel lemma differ.
findings.proposed_change:
Add one general lemma, e.g.
`theorem exists_coord_ne_one_of_isPGroup_ker {G ι : Type*} {H : ι → Type*} [Group G] [∀ i, Group (H i)] (φ : G →* (∀ i, H i)) (hker : IsPGroup 2 φ.ker) {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) (hp2 : p ≠ 2) {g : G} (hg : g ^ p = 1) (hg1 : g ≠ 1) : ∃ j, φ g j ≠ 1`.
Proof sketch: by_contra and push_neg to get ∀ j, φ g j = 1, so φ g = 1 by funext. Then g ∈ φ.ker, so hker ⟨g, _⟩ gives k with g^(2^k)=1. Hence orderOf g = p divides 2^k, so p ∣ 2 by `hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow`, and p = 2 by `Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq`, contradicting hp2.
In this file, lines 148-158 become `obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_coord_ne_one_of_isPGroup_ker (orthLeviHom b c hd) (isPGroup_ker_orthLeviHom hd) hp (by omega) hg hg1`. The `hβ` and `by_contra` blocks go away, and `hord` is only needed for its other uses. `exists_uniLeviHom_ne_one` in UBlocks becomes the same one-line call with `isPGroup_ker_uniLeviHom h hε hI`. The OP proof at lines 95-105 uses `hker'` and `MonoidHom.pi β'` and also reduces to the call.
findings.benefit: The kernel-is-a-2-group argument is stated and proved once instead of three times. The later uses read as one application each. Any fix, such as the p=2 handling, only needs to be made in one place.
